# Project Phoenix v49.0 — World Megaprojects & Wonders Race Yearly Pulse Dispatcher.
# Strictly R10 / R28 / G_ELR_ISOLATION compliant.
# Generated by gen_v490_world_megaprojects.py; edit the generator, not this file.

yearly_country_pulse = {
	on_actions = {
		oe_v49_wdr_yearly_sync_pulse
		oe_v49_wdr_yearly_rivalry_pulse
	}
}

# All-era country wonder count sync (no event dispatch; keeps GUI counters exact in every bookmark).
oe_v49_wdr_yearly_sync_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
			oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_v49_wdr_sync_country_counts_effect = yes
	}
}

# G_ELR_ISOLATION-guarded global rivalry & exposition event dispatcher (`oe_v49_wdr.27` & `.28`).
oe_v49_wdr_yearly_rivalry_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_v49_wonders_off }
		is_situation_active = situation:oe_sit_v49_wonders_race
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { country_type = pop }
		NOT = { country_type = building }
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_ev_cd }
		OR = {
			is_ai = no
			is_great_power = yes
		}
		oe_main_mod_global_event_allowed = yes
		oe_v49_wdr_owns_any_megaproject = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_27_seen } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_27_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v49_wdr.27
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_28_seen }
				oe_v49_wdr_qualifies_golden_age = yes
			}
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_28_seen value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_v49_wdr_ev_cd value = 1 days = 420 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_v49_wdr.28
		}
	}
}
